about: David Gerger is an attorney who represents clients in the Houston, Texas area. David Gerger is recognized by peers and was selected to Super Lawyers for 2003 - 2026. This selection is based off of an evaluation of 12 indicators including peer recognition and professional achievement in legal practice.

David Gerger chose to pursue a career in law after completing undergraduate studies. He attended The University of Texas School of Law and graduated in 1985. David Gerger passed the bar exam and was admitted to legal practice in 1985.
He represents clients with Criminal Defense: White Collar issues in Texas. He also represents clients with Criminal Defense issues.

Being selected to Super Lawyers is limited to a small number of attorneys in each state. As one of the few attorneys to garner the distinction of Super Lawyers, David Gerger has earned the respect of peers as one of the top-rated attorneys in the nation.
